source: blockwise-symbol-profile, MEASURED 2026-10-04 from the live editor (outputs/118/apply_report.json pin read-back; outputs/110/11_pins.json + 12_bodies.json for names/directions/lengths). Built by tools/118_measure_profiles.py — do not hand-edit: a profile is a set of claims about one library symbol, and 113's hand-written ones were refused by 054 C6 on contact.

profiles.title:
Resistor 0603, axial (two pins on the horizontal axis), drawn vertically with pin 1 (the row end) UP, so the part's chain/row pin presents on a horizontal line — the feedback row 岳 ruling (e) asks for.

DIO-DO41-UF4007 — the clamp diode (D1), drawn with its ANODE on the left and its CATHODE on the right, so the winding it hangs off leaves horizontally.
